_about: Accounts a human confirmed are bot / farm accounts (inverse of not-farm.json). The padding filter (padding.mjs isFarmVictim) always treats them as farm victims, whatever the automatic thresholds, so kills on them are excluded for every player; they are listed under 🤖 on build-log.html and left out of ranks.json. Keyed by bare character name (lowercase, no outfit tag); cid is checked too. Add entries by hand: "name": { "cid": "…", "display": "…", "reason": "why", "at": "YYYY-MM-DD" }.
